question: Who won the 2025 Formula One World Championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lando Norris.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Lando Norris was crowned the 2025 Formula One World Champion after the Abu Dhabi season finale.**
 
• **Despite Max Verstappen winning the race, Norris secured enough points with a P3 finish to take the title.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lando Norris became World Champion for the first time in 2025.**
 
• He races for McLaren and finished third in the final race to secure the championship.
 
• McLaren also sealed the Teams' Championship this season.
 
• The title marks McLaren’s first drivers’ championship in over a decade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Max Verstappen**__ won the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2025 but missed the championship despite his fifth Yas Marina victory.
 
• __**Oscar Piastri**__ finished second in the final race, playing a key strategic role for McLaren.
 
• Charles Leclerc and George Russell fought behind, but couldn’t influence the title outcome.
 
• Norris overcame a season setback including a DNF at Zandvoort where he trailed by 34 points earlier.
